brief: The LinkedIn strategy that built me a 6-figure consulting pipeline.

slots.title: Optimize Your Profile for Conversions
slots.body: Your profile is your landing page. Use a clear headline that speaks to client pain points, not just your job title. Include a compelling call-to-action in your featured section.

slots.title: Define Three Content Pillars
slots.body: Focus on industry insights, client case studies, and personal lessons. This builds authority while showing real-world results. Consistency beats virality when attracting serious buyers.

slots.title: Post Valuable Insights Daily
slots.body: Share one thoughtful post every weekday. Teach something useful from your consulting work. Visibility compounds when your audience begins relying on your expertise.

slots.title: Engage With Target Accounts Daily
slots.body: Spend twenty minutes commenting on posts from ideal clients and industry leaders. Add genuine insights, not generic praise. This builds recognition before you ever send a pitch.

slots.title: Send Contextual Direct Messages
slots.body: Reach out only after meaningful engagement. Reference their recent post or a shared connection. Keep your message short and focused on starting a conversation, not selling.

slots.title: Create a Simple Lead Capture
slots.body: Link to a calendar or newsletter in every post. Make it effortless for interested prospects to take the next step. One clear path converts followers into paying clients.

slots.headline: Start Building Today
slots.body: Which step will you implement first? Drop a comment below and let me know how I can help.
